title: Mia and the Playground
text:
Mia likes the playground. It is green and has a big slide. In summer, Mia plays there every day. She swings with her friend Leo.

In winter, the playground is cold and quiet. Mia wears a warm coat and a hat. She still likes to play in the snow. Leo likes it too.

questions.text: What does Mia wear in winter?
options: A warm coat and a hat

questions.text: How does Mia probably feel about playing in the snow?
Why is the playground quiet in winter?
options: Fewer children play outside in the cold

vocabulary.definition: an outdoor area where children play
a smooth structure that children go down for fun
white frozen water that falls from the sky
the coldest season of the year

paragraph_translations: A Mia le gusta el parque infantil. Es verde y tiene un tobogán grande. En verano, Mia juega allí todos los días. Se columpia con su amigo Leo.
En invierno, el parque infantil está frío y tranquilo. Mia lleva un abrigo caliente y un gorro. Todavía le gusta jugar en la nieve. A Leo también le gusta.
